[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Christian Glasgow''' was recorded in the Glencorse baptism register on 15 February 1708, a daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson.<ref name="Christian1708">“Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” database, ''FamilySearch'', [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4J-CB3 Christian Glasgow, 15 February 1708].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3011]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Christian’s 1708 baptism explicitly names Robert and Margaret Davidson; their 1704 Glencorse marriage and the only indexed local Robert childhood in the reviewed 1640–1690 search favour Robert-3011. That 1676 child-to-groom bridge is still inferred.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; 1676 Glencorse child to 1704 Davidson groom/father is a probable identity, not a literal statement in the child records; shipmaster identity remains separate.

Next useful test: Seek a 1704 marriage/baptism original identifying Robert’s occupation, residence or father.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4J-CB3 “Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” database, FamilySearch, Christian Glasgow, 15 February 1708 (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4J-CB3).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The baptism directly identifies Christian's parents by name. It does not identify her father as [[Glasgow-2867|Robert Glasgow]], master of the ''John and Archibald'' in 1754; that shipmaster identification is unsupported and should remain uncertain.

[[Glasgow-3011|Robert Glasgow (1676-)]] is the probable candidate for the Glencorse father: he is the only indexed Robert Glasgow baptism in Glencorse from 1640 to 1690.<ref name="Robert1676">Scotland's People, Church of Scotland old parish registers, Robert Glasgow, 29 December 1676, parents John Glasgow and Margaret Currie, Glencorse parish 687, reference 10/8; exact-name search for local Robert Glasgow baptisms, 1640–1690.</ref> A same-name man married [[Davidson-20783|Margaret Davidson]] there on 8 June 1704.<ref name="GlencorseMarriage1704">Scotland's People, Church of Scotland old parish registers, Robert Glasgow and Margarett Davidson, 8 June 1704, Glencorse parish 687, reference 20/53.</ref> The marriage index supplies no age, parents, or occupation, so this is not proof of identity. Any future controlled replacement of Glasgow-2867 with Glasgow-3011 must retain an uncertain father relationship.
